script: Remember when NASA intentionally crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid? It wasn't science fiction, it was planetary defense in action! Now, years later, the European Space Agency's Hera mission has arrived to survey the damage, revealing a truly bizarre aftermath. What they found wasn't just a crater, but a 'strange new world' unlike anything we've ever seen. The impact created a massive, unstable debris field around Dimorphos. The moonlet itself is now wobbling, its orbit fundamentally changed, giving scientists critical data on how to protect Earth from future threats. A truly wild discovery!
